findings.claim: Task 3's source check requires the literal identifier 'trailList' before .addEventListener, so a behaviorally correct delegated listener attached via document.querySelector("#trail-list").addEventListener(...) (or a renamed variable) false-fails the source scan even though every behavioral assertion in the same test would pass.
findings.recommendation: Widen the regex to also accept a fresh query of the list element or verify delegation behaviorally only (the later filtered-render click already proves it) and drop the identifier check.

findings.recommendation: Append the missing info lines in reporter order to match the html-and-css lab's accepted expected-output convention.
